core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mannan is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Bountiful, generous, gracious”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mannan corresponds to the Arabic form منان (Arabic root م ن ن (m-n-n); مَنَّان (Mannān)). Its core sense is bountiful, generous, gracious. Mannan is Arabic مَنَّان (Mannān) 'bountiful, generous, gracious', from the root م ن ن (m-n-n); it is also one of the names of Allah (المنان). The source gloss 'Support, Comfort' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
